note: Quick, Draw! helmet 6320704582582272, seen from the side with the peak to the right: the dome in one line (3), the top edge of the band (0), the left edge of the band (1), the brim's upper line running out to the peak at the right (2), and its lower line (4). The helmet is a rigid object held in two hands, so the rig keeps the whole doodle as drawn and places it by two points: the lower left corner of the band and the peak at the right, where the strap clip sits on the real helmet. The drawing rises into frame from the upper left, settles and tilts with the helmet, and keeps one size; it is drawn 1.2 times wider than tall relative to the doodle so that the doodle's tall band fits the real helmet's flatter outline.
